proposed_widenings.name: class_feature_on_hit_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Brutal Strike modifies one existing Strength-based attack roll made during the Attack action after choosing to forgo Reckless Attack's advantage; class features cannot currently attach an on-hit rider to an already-existing attack procedure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn. If the chosen attack roll hits...

proposed_widenings.name: damageTypeRef.triggering_attack_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The bonus damage inherits the triggering weapon or Unarmed Strike's damage type, but `damage.damageType` only supports a fixed type or closed choice.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike

proposed_widenings.name: move_self
proposed_widenings.justification: Forceful Blow grants voluntary self-movement toward the target tied to half the user's Speed. The current surface only supports forced movement of another creature or teleportation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

notes: Stopped before authoring Dhall/JSON because encoding this as a standard activation would create a fake standalone attack roll instead of modifying an existing Attack-action hit. Hamstring Blow also needs turn-bounded attachment semantics once the primary on-hit family exists.
